independent_prefix_proof.global_interleaving_argument: At any global prefix, every exact-once source term has coefficient in {-1,0,+1}; triangle inequality bounds the channel accumulator by sum(abs(weight)) regardless of inter-term ordering.
independent_prefix_proof.retry_attack: Duplicating an accepted anchor, positive correction, negative correction or escape raw event produces coefficient magnitude two in reachable abstract attack traces; unbounded retries have no finite width bound.

findings.finding: The prefix theorem is conditional on each accepted anchor/correction/escape event executing exactly once, but no integrated controller-to-accumulator accepted-transaction miter covers stall, retry, reset, flush and escape replay.
findings.impact: A duplicate accepted operation can drive a per-term coefficient to magnitude two, while unbounded retry defeats every finite arithmetic width. signed19/signed21 remain mathematical candidates only.
findings.suggested_action: Build a fail-closed accepted-transaction scoreboard/miter that assigns a unique term identity, proves one-and-only-one accumulator application under backpressure/reset/escape, and attacks duplicated acceptance explicitly.

findings.finding: No signed19 accumulator RTL or full-lane commercial-VCS numeric replay is admitted by M115-r2.
findings.impact: The mathematical candidate does not yet prove truncation/sign-extension behavior, overflow assertions, lazy-valid reset behavior or integration correctness.
findings.suggested_action: After exact-once closure, implement signed19 with overflow SVA and compare accepted full-lane results against a wider golden accumulator over directed and heldout streams.

findings.finding: The storage frontier has no foundry SRAM organization/rounding/periphery, ECC, controller/interconnect, timing, power or equal-area comparison.
findings.impact: 20.26% logical-byte saving cannot be translated into SRAM area/energy, cycle, physical, system or headline advantage. M115-r2 correctly keeps every such admission false.

findings.finding: The result says all legal term cases and orders were enumerated, but legal_cases_all_service_orders contains only the four eligible PWP center/target cases. Escape is represented by a textual contract, not generated cases.
findings.impact: Independent enumeration of all four escape center/target combinations still gives prefix magnitude at most one, so the theorem is unchanged; the admission wording is broader than the machine enumeration.
findings.suggested_action: Add eligible as an explicit dimension and emit all eight PWP/escape cases, or rename the admission to all_eligible_pwp_cases_enumerated.

findings.finding: The four accumulator-init payloads are all zero and all four convolutions are bias-free, but M115-r2 does not directly read/hash/assert those facts when applying an absolute accumulator magnitude bound.
findings.impact: The pinned M41 root is safe; a future nonzero initial value or bias would need to be added to the bound.

findings.finding: The contract frozen_identity omits the four weight payload roots; revocation and triggering-review roots are kept in supersedes rather than the frozen_identity block.
findings.impact: The result and producer manifest pin these roots, so present identity is intact; one canonical identity block would simplify fail-closed consumption.

findings.finding: SHA256SUMS.complete_r1 covers every direct analyzer input and all weights, but omits the triggering review manifest and the three revoked r1 artifacts whose hashes are validated transitively through the revocation.
findings.impact: This is a complete direct-input manifest, not a standalone transitive evidence bundle. The independent review manifest closes those roots.

findings.finding: The result reports only per-operator extrema and maximum-channel indices, not a digest/ledger for all 3,072 recomputed channel sums.
findings.impact: Independent reproduction succeeds; publishing the four u32le ledger digests would make all-channel recomputation directly auditable.
